manual.title: Verify MSc completion date vs Tampere HTI start (Sept 2026, negotiable) and confirm degree/transcript requirements can be met
manual.notes: Posting requires a completed relevant Master's degree with transcript. Confirm expected MMU MSc completion date, and whether a negotiated later start or conditional offer is possible. Blocks the apply decision.

outcome.note: CONCLUSION (evidence tampere/3110): the posting expects applicants to hold an applicable Master's degree and lists 'a transcript of records from completed Master's degree studies' among required application materials; start is 'preferably September 2026' but explicitly negotiable. User's expected MSc completion is 2027-07 (ESTIMATED, user-confirmed). Because the start is negotiable, this is not a clear fixed-start failure -> eligibility_gate stays uncertain and a recruiter question is required (act_hti_ask_recruiter_timing). The provisional 'apply' recommendation is NOT preserved; downgraded to consider pending the recruiter's answer.
